name: joy2know-suno-maestro
description: joy2know Suno Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste prompt pack for Suno — a title, an optimized Style line that locks language and accent in the first field (nine fields for vocals, instrumental and seamless-loop variants), and section-tagged lyrics with explicit repeats. Specialises in healing folk and dialect songs (Cantonese word-locks and tonal compensation stop cracked pronunciation), and plans whole albums (album brief intake, tone tokens, track table, difference matrix, time-signature and mode rationale, per-track prompts and cover prompts). Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste prompt pack for Suno (title, Style, lyrics), and plans whole albums. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 把想法写成可粘贴进 Suno 的歌曲包（标题 + Style + 歌词），也规划整张专辑：曲目表、差异矩阵、逐首提示词。仅产出文本。
